Beneath the ocean’s surface lie lost pirate treasures, hidden gold and secrets tied to military operations. In Mysteries of the Deep, Jeremy Wade explores underwater mysteries, investigates remarkable recoveries and follows clues that could reveal what the sea has kept hidden for decades.
From legendary treasure to high-stakes underwater missions, what will these discoveries reveal about the secrets buried beneath the waves?
Watch Mysteries of the Deep, Season 1, Episodes 6, 10, 4, 8, 2, 9, 1 and 7, on Discovery Channel India.
